name: Chris Good
occupation: Business owner; owns and operates Quality Propane in Powell and fireworks outlets in Powell and Cody.
background: He first filed for HD25 in 2020 but withdrew after his wife, Miria, suffered serious brain injuries in a fall on June 3, 2020; his name remained on that year’s ballot. He told the Tribune her recovery was “almost a miracle” and that he filed again in 2022 once he realized she would not need full-time care.
